messages:
Alex: deploy-bot kicked off canary rollout v2.3.1 to eu1 at 14:00 UTC — 10% traffic.
deploy-bot: Canary started for service=runtime version=2.3.1 canary=10%
canary-bot: synth probe 'kv-warmup' in eu1 -> 502 x12/50 (24%), p95=740ms > threshold 600ms :warning:
Priya: seeing the p95 jump on the SLO board, seems isolated to eu1, other regions look stable
Ryan: running quick /deploy status — hosts healthy overall but one pool eu1-03 showing repeated prefix-cache-miss logs
Infra-Oncall: tailing eu1-03: `2026-03-20T14:02:11Z ERROR runtime.kv: handshake timeout (peer redis)` — repeating every ~3s
Jasmine: note: change window 14:00-15:00 UTC, release notes call out "kv cache warmup improvements" for this change
Alex: canary is only 10% but those 502s are concerning. options: rollback, pin region to previous version, or hold rollout and debug. thoughts?
Priya: prefer to hold/pin for eu1 — rollback global would be heavier. pin eu1 back to v2.2.9 and pause canary in eu1 while infra investigates
Ryan: agree. applying routing pin now: `routing.pin(region=eu1, version=2.2.9) // deploy-cli`
deploy-bot: Routing update applied — eu1 traffic pinned to v2.2.9, v2.3.1 canary paused for eu1 :white_check_mark:
canary-bot: re-running 'kv-warmup' against v2.3.1 in eu1 (synthetics): 502 x8/30, p95=680ms — failing but fewer samples
Infra-Oncall: hypothesis: redis connection pool sizing/regression in new image. spinning debug job and enabling extra logging on eu1-03
Priya: Jasmine, can you draft a short blurb for release notes & change window? we should notify customers in eu region of a hold
Jasmine: writing announcement to #announcements and adding to release doc: "Canary hold in EU for v2.3.1 due to kv warmup errors; investigating; global rollout paused." will link incident page
Alex: good. Plan after infra fix: re-run canary with staggered warmup, increased prefill, and extra KV-prefill probe. avoid immediate rollback unless production traffic shows errors
Ryan: staging patch ready that tweaks redis pool and prefill timing, running integration tests now
Priya: tagging this as rollout:hold and incident:minor. logging action items in rollout doc (prefill tuning, additional logs, postmortem owner)
Jasmine: announcement posted: <https://status.redwood.ai/incident/4032109876|EU canary held — 2.3.1>. Will update release notes entry accordingly
Alex: thanks. leave this thread open until eu1 synths are green and we either resume or rollback. re-open if any customer-facing errors are reported :thumbsup:
meta: post-deploy coordination: canary hold + routing pin due to synthetic kv warmup failures in eu1; short thread, quick decision to pin rather than full rollback
